input: Metric name: Daily completion rate. Purpose: monitor batch completion. Formula: completed batches during a UTC day / batches started during that UTC day. Population: production batches. Exclude test batches. Grain: batch. Window: 00:00–23:59 UTC. Freshness: by 02:00 UTC next day. Zero-denominator policy: undefined. Do not calculate a result.

expected_artifact.formula: completed batches during a UTC day / batches started during that UTC day
expected_artifact.numerator: Production batches completed during the UTC day
expected_artifact.denominator: Production batches started during the same UTC day
expected_artifact.zero_policy: undefined when no production batches started
source_notes: All definition fields come from the supplied metric note.
